name: anim_jyu_slam_sway3
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: Loop: facing straight toward the viewer with both hands on his hips, he slowly and sensually grinds his hips left and right in a sticky, teasing rhythm. As he sways to each side his whole body goes with it: the upper body turns slightly toward that side so one shoulder comes forward, the opposite knee bends so the body dips and rises, and the head tilts and moves along with the body while still looking down at the viewer. The chest and the big belly roll heavily with the motion, the feet stay planted. The face keeps exactly the same eyebrows, nose, closed mouth and half-lidded eyes with a heavy smug gaze. Thick, sticky, viscous paint, slow and heavy.
